cohort: The study enrolled 325 postpartum patients who delivered either by cesarean section or vaginal delivery at Shalamar Hospital, Lahore, Pakistan.
finding: The overall incidence of PPH was 19.4%, with cesarean delivery (AOR: 2.4), maternal anemia (AOR: 3.2), and prolonged labor (AOR: 1.9) identified as independent predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean deliveries had a significantly higher rate of PPH (26.5%) compared to vaginal deliveries (12.3%), and cesarean delivery was an independent predictor of PPH.
gest_age: Gestational age was collected as a demographic detail, but specific ranges or details for the cohort are not provided.
